gates.name: Windows regression checks
gates.evidence: 0.12: 93 safe Windows checks and 48 Rust core + 2 C ABI checks passed, including native P2P. Paired resume operations, annotation clear/stale-generation rejection, legacy recursive files and permanent access interoperated between Windows and Rust. These use synthetic capture and isolated credentials, not physical WAN acceptance.

gates.name: Two physical PCs on different networks
gates.evidence: Installed host remains 0.3; update/owner acceptance are separate.

gates.name: Verified interrupted-transfer resume
gates.evidence: Windows native resume checks and portable interrupted upload/download tests passed. Portable tests verify that only the authenticated suffix is sent, with wrong-key isolation, locks, corrupt-prefix cancellation, digest binding and explicit-cancel cleanup. Paired single-file retry only; folder jobs do not resume.

gates.name: Owner-configured network-share roots
gates.evidence: Implemented owner-configured roots and allowlist/discovery checks; actual SMB endpoint not tested.

gates.name: Microphone, two-way voice and MP4 audio tracks
gates.evidence: Windows MP4 and portable MKV are implemented. Portable synthetic TLS consent/decline/generation and rapid-toggle tests passed; independent FFmpeg video/stereo decode and actual Linux null-sink playback/capture passed. Physical microphones/speakers and mobile device execution remain unverified.

gates.name: Remote printing
gates.evidence: Windows PDF forwarding/rendering and Microsoft Print to PDF spool have prior evidence. 0.12 adds bounded portable snapshots, Linux CUPS selection, Android PrintManager and Apple source adapters. Snapshot and printer-name tests passed; the new adapters have no physical printer/device acceptance.

gates.name: Linux native implementation and tests
gates.evidence: 0.12 Alpine X11 VM: 50 core + 2 C ABI, 1 printer-name parser, 2 native X11, 1 protected keyring/daemon lifecycle and 1 virtual PCM test passed. Optimized native app executed. Physical desktop, WAN, other distributions, CUPS/physical printer and Wayland control remain unverified/unavailable.

gates.name: macOS native implementation/build
gates.evidence: Owner explicitly accepts Apple preparation without compilation or execution because no Apple device is available. macOS/iOS source, read-only preflight, universal build recipe and bundle checks are prepared. README states the unverified status. This is an exception, not a passed build.

gates.name: macOS execution tests
gates.evidence: Owner explicitly confirmed no Apple devices are available; macOS and iOS/iPadOS were not compiled or tested. Accepted preparation-only exception.

gates.name: Mobile platform roles and implementations
gates.evidence: 0.12 Android ARM64/x86-64 native libraries, app and separate instrumentation APK compiled. Lint: zero errors, 13 warnings. PDF print and annotation adapters compiled. Signature, 16 KiB alignment and all eight native library identities passed. Device execution remains unverified. macOS/iOS remain uncompiled/untested because no Apple devices are available. Mobile hosting is not implemented.

gates.name: Owner ACLs, lock/login/reboot, audio and wake
gates.evidence: Synthetic tests do not establish physical/installed-service behaviour.

gates.name: Independent code/security review
gates.evidence: AGY CLI Gemini 3.8 Flash High with effort high completed a static review of 0.11 changes and a focused re-review. Two confirmed P3 findings were fixed; no critical finding was identified within reviewed source. Broader security/device acceptance remains pending. This is not a security certification or an Opus audit. See docs/AGY-11-REVIEW.md.

gates.name: Relay/updates/distribution trust
gates.evidence: No managed TURN fleet, signed auto-update channel or publisher signing.

source_publication.scope: Public development source preview. Does not waive production acceptance gates.
